say:0:1536017001:1.text: At the center of the plaza stands a fountain, its base covered with Halian coins. Now and then, someone passes by, tosses in a coin, clasps their hands, and makes a wish.
say:0:1536017001:1.source_cn: 广场中央的喷泉，最底部厚厚地铺了一层呼临城通用的货币。...

say:1:1536017002:1.text: Here it is, the wishing fountain. For ages untold, people have been tossing coins in here for a bit of luck. After all this time, it's amazing the ritual still lives on.
say:1:1536017002:1.source_cn: 没错了，这里就是许愿池。人们对好运的追求还真是执着，居...

choice_prompt:2:1536017002.text: Here it is, the wishing fountain. For ages untold, people have been tossing coins in here for a bit of luck. After all this time, it's amazing the ritual still lives on.
choice_prompt:2:1536017002.source_cn: 没错了，这里就是许愿池。人们对好运的追求还真是执着，居然在万年前就形成了这一习俗……你不禁为之赞叹。

say:3:1536017003:1.text: You take out a coin. Once it drops in, it'll be time to make a wish.
say:3:1536017003:1.source_cn: 你拿出了一枚硬币。待会把硬币丢下去后，就是许愿环节了。
say:3:1536017003:1.male: You take out a coin. Once it drops in, it'll be time to make a wish.
say:3:1536017003:1.female: You take out a coin. Once it drops in, it'll be time to make a wish.

say:4:1536017004:1.text: What should you wish for? As a mage, you know how much of life hinges on luck. You close your eyes and wish for just that—a little more luck on your side.
say:4:1536017004:1.source_cn: 要许什么愿呢？身为魔法师，你深知幸运的重要性。你决定向...
say:4:1536017004:1.male: What should you wish for? As a mage, you know how much of life hinges on luck. You close your eyes and wish for just that—a little more luck on your side.
say:4:1536017004:1.female: What should you wish for? As a mage, you know how much of life hinges on luck. You close your eyes and wish for just that—a little more luck on your side.

narration:5:1536017005:0.text: The coin lands with a crisp clink...
narration:5:1536017005:0.source_cn: 硬币落入池中，发出了清脆的碰撞声……

narration:6:1536017006:0.text: And to your surprise, it bounces and ricochets around until it flips back into your hand!
narration:6:1536017006:0.source_cn: 在你惊讶的目光中，硬币在池底多次碰撞，竟然又弹回了你的手里！
narration:6:1536017006:0.male: And to your surprise, it bounces and ricochets around until it flips back into your hand!
narration:6:1536017006:0.female: And to your surprise, it bounces and ricochets around until it flips back into your hand!

say:7:1536017007:1.text: Well... not exactly the blessing you hoped for, but hey, getting your money back's a kind of luck too.
say:7:1536017007:1.source_cn: 好吧，虽然有点小……但也算是幸运吧？至少你什么也没损失。
say:7:1536017007:1.male: Well... not exactly the blessing you hoped for, but hey, getting your money back's a kind of luck too.
say:7:1536017007:1.female: Well... not exactly the blessing you hoped for, but hey, getting your money back's a kind of luck too.

say:9:1536017008:0.text: Wishes, luck, blessings... all nonsense! Real power? That's in your hands. Literally.
say:9:1536017008:0.source_cn: 什么许愿什么好运，统统都是虚的。东西，永远都是握在自己...
say:9:1536017008:0.male: Wishes, luck, blessings... all nonsense! Real power? That's in your hands. Literally.
say:9:1536017008:0.female: Wishes, luck, blessings... all nonsense! Real power? That's in your hands. Literally.

say:10:1536017009:0.text: Alright, time to get your hands dirty. Scoop them all up!
say:10:1536017009:0.source_cn: 来吧，俯下身，准备大干一场吧！
say:10:1536017009:0.male: Alright, time to get your hands dirty. Scoop them all up!
say:10:1536017009:0.female: Alright, time to get your hands dirty. Scoop them all up!

say:12:1536017010:0.text: HEY! What do you think you're doing?!
say:12:1536017010:0.male: HEY! What do you think you're doing?!
say:12:1536017010:0.female: HEY! What do you think you're doing?!

say:13:1536017011:0.text: Were you just scooping coins out of the wishing fountain?
say:13:1536017011:0.source_cn: 你刚刚是不是在捞许愿池里的硬币！
say:13:1536017011:0.male: Were you just scooping coins out of the wishing fountain?
say:13:1536017011:0.female: Were you just scooping coins out of the wishing fountain?

say:16:1536017013:1.text: At least you owned up to it. I'll let it slide this time, but don't try it again!
say:16:1536017013:1.source_cn: 改正态度还不错，这次就不追究了。下次不许这么做了！
say:16:1536017013:1.male: At least you owned up to it. I'll let it slide this time, but don't try it again!
say:16:1536017013:1.female: At least you owned up to it. I'll let it slide this time, but don't try it again!

say:17:1536017014:1.text: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!
say:17:1536017014:1.source_cn: 你还不服！你要是再不放回去，依照律法，就要投牢！
say:17:1536017014:1.male: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!
say:17:1536017014:1.female: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!

choice_prompt:18:1536017014.text: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!
choice_prompt:18:1536017014.source_cn: 你还不服！你要是再不放回去，依照律法，就要投牢！
choice_prompt:18:1536017014.male: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!
choice_prompt:18:1536017014.female: Enough talk! Return the coins at once, or we'll throw you in a cell. It's the law!

say:19:1536017015:0.text: Doesn't matter. This is Halian territory, and you'll follow our rules. Give them up!
say:19:1536017015:0.source_cn: 但你现在在呼临城，就得遵守呼临的法律！快把硬币交出来！
say:19:1536017015:0.male: Doesn't matter. This is Halian territory, and you'll follow our rules. Give them up!
say:19:1536017015:0.female: Doesn't matter. This is Halian territory, and you'll follow our rules. Give them up!

narration:20:1536017016:0.text: Well, that didn't work. You drop the coins back into the fountain. The clinks sound like little heartbreaks...
narration:20:1536017016:0.source_cn: 辩论失败，你只能将硬币扔回了许愿池。叮叮当当，心碎的声音……
narration:20:1536017016:0.male: Well, that didn't work. You drop the coins back into the fountain. The clinks sound like little heartbreaks...
narration:20:1536017016:0.female: Well, that didn't work. You drop the coins back into the fountain. The clinks sound like little heartbreaks...

choice:18:0:1.text: I'm not even Halian. Your laws don't apply!
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 我不是呼临人，管不了我！
choice:18:0:1.male: I'm not even Halian. Your laws don't apply!
choice:18:0:1.female: I'm not even Halian. Your laws don't apply!

say:23:1536017018:1.text: I... hadn't thought of it like that. It still feels wrong, somehow. I just can't put my finger on why...
say:23:1536017018:1.source_cn: 这……这我倒没想过……总觉得哪里不对，但说不出来……
say:23:1536017018:1.male: I... hadn't thought of it like that. It still feels wrong, somehow. I just can't put my finger on why...
say:23:1536017018:1.female: I... hadn't thought of it like that. It still feels wrong, somehow. I just can't put my finger on why...

narration:24:1536017019:0.text: While the guard wrestles with philosophy 101, you scoop the rest and bolt.
narration:24:1536017019:0.source_cn: 趁卫兵还在踌躇不定，你揽上所有的硬币，成功开溜！
narration:24:1536017019:0.male: While the guard wrestles with philosophy 101, you scoop the rest and bolt.
narration:24:1536017019:0.female: While the guard wrestles with philosophy 101, you scoop the rest and bolt.

narration:25:1536017020:0.text: Congratulations! You've proven it: luck's not in the stars. It's in your pockets.
narration:25:1536017020:0.source_cn: 你就说嘛——幸运，是掌握在自己手里的！
narration:25:1536017020:0.male: Congratulations! You've proven it: luck's not in the stars. It's in your pockets.
narration:25:1536017020:0.female: Congratulations! You've proven it: luck's not in the stars. It's in your pockets.

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 那些人把硬币主动丢在了喷泉……

choice:22:1:2.text: All I did was pick them up!
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 我只是把它们捡起来了而已！
choice:22:1:2.male: All I did was pick them up!
choice:22:1:2.female: All I did was pick them up!

choice:18:1:2.text: But those coins don't belong to anyone!
choice:18:1:2.male: But those coins don't belong to anyone!
choice:18:1:2.female: But those coins don't belong to anyone!
